catalysts.name: Cleveland-Cliffs Inc.
catalysts.what: Cleveland-Cliffs' Q3 2026 adjusted EBITDA of $612M beat its own prior guidance of $575M, with adjusted EPS of $0.28 vs $0.21 expected; management guided Q4 2026 adjusted EBITDA to ~$715M (up ~$103M on higher steel pricing) and said it expects a major Q4 debt reduction. Shares jumped on the outlook (SEC 8-K, Exhibit 99.1, filed 19 Oct).

catalysts.name: Datadog, Inc.
catalysts.what: Bernstein upgraded Datadog to Outperform from Market Perform on 19 Oct and raised its price target to $350 from $237 (implies roughly 37% upside from this run's FMP price), citing AI token usage growing at least 50% and saying its prior caution (tied to a large 'Born in AI' customer ARR cut) was too conservative. Shares rose on the upgrade after the prior week's broad tech selloff. Datadog reports Q3 2026 results 4 Nov.

catalysts.name: Albemarle Corporation
catalysts.what: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral on 14 Oct (analyst John Roberts) and set a $130 price target (implies roughly 36% upside from this run's FMP price), citing accelerating battery energy-storage demand tightening lithium market conditions; Mizuho also raised its Albemarle adjusted-EBITDA estimates to $3.2B (2027) and $2.9B (2028) on firmer Benchmark Minerals lithium-carbonate price forecasts ($22,500/t 2027, $19,500/t 2028). Albemarle reports Q3 2026 results 4 Nov.

CLF.what: North American flat-rolled steel producer, vertically integrated into iron ore mining (five mines in Minnesota/Michigan); serves automotive, infrastructure and manufacturing customers.

DDOG.what: Cloud-based observability and security SaaS platform (infrastructure monitoring, APM, log management) for developers and IT operations teams.

ALB.what: Specialty chemicals producer (lithium, bromine, catalysts) supplying batteries, electronics and industrial markets.
